paragraphs: Rav Chana said: R. Yehudah said: Shmuel said, etc. Rav Chana sat and had difficulty, etc. R. Yosef told Rav Chana, “The Master, etc.”: Shabbat 97a, near the end. But Maharshal emends to “Rav Chisda said: R. Yehudah said.” He emended thus because this is the reading in Tosafot, Shabbat, chapter 1, 4b, under “He threw and it rested”: it is difficult according to the texts reading “Rav Chisda sat and had difficulty, etc.; Rav Yosef said to him, ‘The Master, etc.’” However, Rabbenu Tam reads “Rav Yosef sat, etc.; Rav Chisda said to him.”
